definitions.gloss: silver seat; priority seat for the elderly and disabled
definitions.explanation: A reserved seat on trains and buses for elderly, disabled, injured, or pregnant passengers. An older Japanese-coined term (from English "silver" + "seat") now largely replaced by {優先席|ゆうせんせき}.

examples.japanese: シルバーシート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit in the priority seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧シルバーシート⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれていた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: It used to be called the 'silver seat.'

examples.japanese: シルバーシート⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{呼|よ}び{方|かた}→呼び方：12125_yobikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優先席|ゆうせんせき}→優先席：06202_yuusenseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わっている→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The term 'silver seat' has now been changed to 'priority seat.'

notes:
A ⟦{和製英語|わせいえいご}→和製英語：18947_waseieigo⟧ (Japanese-made English) coinage first used on Japanese National Railways in 1973. The name came from the silver-gray fabric of the original seats. Now considered dated; ⟦{優先席|ゆうせんせき}→優先席：06202_yuusenseki⟧ is the standard modern term.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優先席|ゆうせんせき}→優先席：06202_yuusenseki⟧: priority seat — the current standard term for the same kind of seat.
